basis: Same source-grounded expectations used in r49; fixed before reader results; explicit development comparison, not a numeric/held-out benchmark

gateDefinitions.mathematicalScope: Preserve sufficient condition a² ≤ 6Eε/(3E+2), a=Δ/√v_FB; integer E>0,T>E, Δ>0, ε>0,0<δ<1; counterexample Δ=1,E=2,T=3,ε=1/4,δ=3/4,0≤S≤9/400; fixed clipped contributions and transcript/average scope; no training-loss/trajectory generalization
gateDefinitions.evidenceDiscipline: Separate exact target resolution, stored checking, model-attributed assessments, no real correspondence/guide approvals, conventional average-only gaps and unchecked adapters, synthetic additional assumptions/historical approval; do not promote inventory completeness to formal coverage
gateDefinitions.actualReuse: Find lemma without evaluator name, preserve its premises, command A independently compiles exact goal/context, B retains/rejects exact boundary-gap premise without declaring goal false
gateDefinitions.ordinaryOperation: Retain all task commands/errors/setup/workarounds/interventions and budget gaps; no root mathematical rescue/internal SQL or shared source/build mutation
gateDefinitions.addedValue: Identify concrete decision/navigation/error avoidance helped by Ladon after same-guide plain comparison; curation, favorable self-report, tests or historical timings alone do not establish added benefit

gradingRules: Check conclusions against source and actual command evidence, not only report prose or guide
Absence of a required answer is incomplete, not automatically an incorrect theorem
Distinguish original reader conclusions from root/evaluator supplements
A failed command is never erased by a later success; count every recorded attempt, record unrecorded work if observed
Worker report is a claim until retained bytes are inspected; explicit diagnosis before correctness repair
If the same useful outcome is reached with native tooling, avoid general or causal superiority claims
stoppingCondition: After one paired attempt and independent grade, pro review should choose the next coherent direction; no model/prompt fishing for successful result or new result-layer features based solely on self-report
